about: Verdicts and reference digests of every authored spec on seeds 0, 1, 2, 41, 97 in its own perception mode ('own') and with perception forced to realistic ('realistic'), recorded from the tier-1 gate record of B6 (B-CLOSE). It is the baseline of TIER1_SWEEP 19.2 for stage C: a package compares its verdicts and reference state digests with these (the gate's compare does it from the gate records; this file is the committed copy, since gate folders are not committed). Only the close steps (B6, C1) or a main-session commit naming the round and the reason re-record it.

modes.own: each spec's own perception mode (oracle unless the spec declares realistic), room camera
modes.realistic: perception forced to realistic, room camera

trial_doc: specs.<id>.<mode>.<seed> = a list in trial_fields order: the verdict fields, the reference plan's final state and observation digests (house_sim.kernel.predicates.digest), its steps and simulated seconds, wrong = [fails, ran] per wrong plan in spec order, error (null when none)

history.reason: first record: stage B (kernel v3.0 physics, camera and robot body) closed
